item.title: Road closure items left behind, 23rd September
item.description:
A40 Lansdown Road / junction with Shelburne Road. Several blue sandbags left in gutter (on A40). Black sandbag on pavement - at base of illuminated 30mph sign) in Shelburne Road (metres from junction). Yellow ADVANCE WARNING sign for road closures on 20th September for half marathon = left leaning against fence. Several other similar warning slings still in position further along A40 (junction with Christ Church Road) and at Westal Green roundabout. All related to half marathon road closures last Sunday. Various other items left behind in other locations too. Why are random items left behind when closures are lifted?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Shelburne Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
